Polish, and Murmur is now open source.

- **Touch animations**: chat rows, the #nearby card and people on Radar/People dip and spring back when you tap them; the online/nearby counts roll when they change. Both follow the system "Remove animations" setting.
- Murmur is now free and open-source under the **Apache-2.0** licence, with a [privacy policy](https://github.com/markovo1234/Murmur/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) (it collects nothing and has no internet permission) and a [contributing guide](https://github.com/markovo1234/Murmur/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- New versions are published here on the Releases page.

---

**Install:** download **`Murmur-v1.3.1.apk`** below and open it on your phone (allow "install unknown apps" if Android asks). `Murmur-v1.3.1-debug.apk` is the debug build: same app, slower animations. Both are signed with the same key, so newer versions install over older ones and keep your chats.
